value_inflection_events.event: Unidentified catalyst; stock price jumped 42.8% potentially on M&A speculation
Leak and confirmation of Amgen's $120/share bid and initiation of formal sale process

leaked_early.details: Amgen's unsolicited $120/share bid was reported by Financial Post on June 28, 2013; Onyx confirmed and launched sale process on June 30. Takeover speculation existed as early as 2012.

notes: Kyprolis was the key value driver; Amgen lowered bid after Onyx refused to unblind FOCUS Phase 3 data, but final $125/sh all-cash deal represents a 44% premium to unaffected price.
